name: starflask_edit_image
description: Edit an existing image with Starflask — change a background, add/remove an object, restyle, fix a detail, extend a scene. Provide `image_url` (the source image, from starflask_upload_media or a prior job's result.image_url) and `prompt` (the edit instruction, e.g. "replace the sky with a sunset", "remove the person on the left", "make the jacket red" — be specific about what changes and what stays). Defaults to the editing-capable model nano-banana-edit, so you don't have to pair a model yourself. Returns a job id immediately ({"data":{"id":"<uuid>"}}) — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.image_url (a downloadable presigned URL). To iterate, feed that result.image_url back in as image_url. (This is starflask_generate_image specialized for the image-in/image-out edit case; for text-to-image from scratch use starflask_generate_image.)

image_url.description: URL of the source image to edit (from starflask_upload_media or a prior image job's result.image_url).

prompt.description: The edit instruction — what to change, while leaving the rest intact. e.g. "replace the sky with a sunset", "remove the person on the left", "make the jacket red".

model_key.description: Optional editing model key. Defaults to nano-banana-edit. Must be an editing-capable model (plain generation models ignore image_url). See starflask_list_models.
